policies.mean_variance: cengine/portfolio_optimization.RegimeMarkowitzAllocator (CVXPY 1.9.3) when reliable expected returns are supplied
policies.risk_based: native C++ _cengine_native.allocate_risk_based (inverse-vol + constraint projection) when reliable returns absent (§7 deterministic fallback)

native_optimization: risk/portfolio_allocator.cpp (bound via bindings/portfolio_bindings.cpp): portfolio_variance/marginal_variance/risk_contributions/inverse_volatility_weights/project_long_only_capped/allocate_risk_based. CPU parity vs numpy ~1e-19 (portfolio variance), inverse-vol exact.
no_fabrication: Heuristic strategy scores are NEVER converted to expected returns; expected_incremental_net_return stays None when uncalibrated; return_basis labeled deterministic_risk_based vs calibrated_mean_variance.
recommendation_contract: cengine/portfolio_optimizer.PortfolioRecommendation (§11): all fields incl. portfolio/optimizer/configuration versions, source_strategy_decision_id linkage, target/current weight, requested qty/notional, capital_required, expected risk contribution, binding constraints, eligibility, rejection_reason.
sizing: target_weight*equity/price -> requested_quantity (fractional only when allow_fractional); revalidated against native risk at order time.
verdict: Native + CVXPY optimization generate valid constrained allocations; recommendation contract complete.
